context_query: SELECT raw_json FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'FreezerMaintenanceTelemetry' AND "$producer" = ? ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 5

health_status.instructions: Evaluate the mechanical health status of the cooling unit compressor.

criteria.NOMINAL: Vibration <= 1.2G, motor temperature <= 65C, and normal refrigerant pressure
criteria.DEGRADED: Moderate vibration (1.2G to 1.8G) or motor warming (65C to 75C)
criteria.CRITICAL: High vibration (1.8G to 2.0G) or motor temperature between 75C and 80C
criteria.FAILURE_IMMINENT: Vibration > 2.0G or motor temperature > 80.0C indicating imminent bearing or stator failure

mapping_template.fault_prediction: payload.vibration_amplitude_g > 2.0 ? 'Bearing wear & excessive mechanical vibration' : (payload.motor_temperature > 80.0 ? 'Compressor stator thermal overload' : 'Mechanical degradation under load')

system_instruction: You are a mechanical predictive maintenance System One evaluator operating on a cooling unit compressor.
semantic_prompt_template:
Analyze the mechanical health of Compressor '{{index .trigger_event "$producer"}}' at locagram '{{index .trigger_event "$where"}}'.

Incoming Event telemetry:
Vibration Amplitude: {{index .trigger_event "fields" "vibration_amplitude_g"}} Gs
Motor Temperature: {{index .trigger_event "fields" "motor_temperature"}} C
Refrigerant Pressure: {{index .trigger_event "fields" "refrigerant_pressure_psi"}} PSI

Historical trend of FreezerMaintenanceTelemetry events (newest first):
{{range .history}}
- At {{index . "$when"}}: Vib: {{index . "fields" "vibration_amplitude_g"}} Gs, Motor Temp: {{index . "fields" "motor_temperature"}} C, Pressure: {{index . "fields" "refrigerant_pressure_psi"}} PSI
{{end}}
